name: Craft on demand
description: Craft new openings for a document from the hub's research, graded against the story checklist. Run by OpenWriter's drh plugin (POST /api/drh/craft-opening), not run_slot.py — file parts become the system message, the input template the user message. Placeholders: {text} (the current opening), {research} (deep-research card snippets), {youtube} (transcript snippets), {checklist} (core checklist items as id + question, injected at call time from W_story_checklist.json), {topic}.
